method: Both WebGL contexts change the same single option. Serial ABBA per scene; each pass uses the existing static benchmark: AB/BA/AB/BA backends, 12 warmup frames and 40 samples per backend per round. New viewers each pass; old renderers disposed and contexts released. Quality sampled once per variant after timing, fresh synchronous canvas capture.
limitations: Single Apple M5 / Chromium 153 / ANGLE Metal device; 120 Hz refresh-limited frame intervals.
GPU queries cover renderer submissions, not complete browser compositing or buffer-preservation work. No memory-peak, moving-sort, cold/hot load or training measurement.
Requested alpha:false, reported context alpha:true for both variants; raw attributes retained.
Only two timed passes per variant per scene; no cross-device or statistical-significance claim.
decision: Keep preserveDrawingBuffer:true for both default viewers: office Gaussian timings overlap while mesh GPU query time increases in both candidate passes. Gaussian-only change remains a separate candidate.
